description: This file defines a singleton object 'PaymentPrefs' that provides persistent storage and retrieval of non-sensitive payment-related preferences, such as the last used payment method and last valid card brand ID, for an Android application. It uses SharedPreferences to store data securely across sessions.

classes.name: PaymentPrefs
classes.description: A singleton object managing lightweight persistent preferences related to payment methods and card brands for checkout.

methods.name: getLastPaymentMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the last selected payment method, if available.

methods.name: setLastPaymentMethod
methods.description: Stores the last selected payment method.

methods.name: getLastValidCardBrandId
methods.description: Retrieves the last valid card brand ID used.

methods.name: setLastValidCardBrandId
methods.description: Stores the last valid card brand ID.

methods.name: getLastPaymentMethod
methods.description: Returns the last used payment method or null.

methods.name: setLastPaymentMethod
methods.description: Saves the provided payment method as the last used.

methods.name: getLastValidCardBrandId
methods.description: Returns the last used valid card brand ID or null if none.

methods.name: setLastValidCardBrandId
methods.description: Saves the provided card brand ID.
